name: OpenIDEA
tagline: The IntelliJ-style code editor rebuilt in Rust - same workflow, opens in under a second, uses a fraction of the memory.
sentence: Opens a 770-file project in 0.9 seconds using 169 MB where IntelliJ (a popular code editor) takes 3.1 seconds and 2 GB, with the same keyboard shortcuts and built-in database and web-request tools.

board.say: Your code editor takes seconds to start, uses gigabytes of memory, and the interface lags on large projects.
You open OpenIDEA and load a project.
Your code project - Python, JavaScript, Go, Rust, or any of 60+ supported languages.
Opens the project almost instantly and loads familiar IntelliJ-style tools.
steps: Opens the project window in under a second (0.9 seconds in the project's own benchmark on a 770-file Python project)
Loads IntelliJ-style tool windows, keyboard shortcuts, and search-everywhere (press Shift twice to search anything)
Runs add-ons (extensions that add features) as sandboxed WebAssembly (a safe container) - the add-on system is in preview

board.say: A ready code editor using a fraction of the memory, with the same workflow you already know.

outputs.eg: A 770-file Python project loads in 0.9 seconds using 169 MB, vs. 3.1 seconds and about 2 GB in IntelliJ
Database browser, web-request tester, Git interface, and terminal - all in one window

before: IntelliJ takes 3.1 seconds to show the window and 13.2 seconds until ready, using about 2 GB of memory
Lightweight editors lack the integrated database, web-request, and debugger tools that full editors have
after: Window in 0.9 seconds, ready in 1.1 seconds, using 169 MB (project's own benchmark, 770-file Python project)
Full code editor with debugger, Git, database, web-request tester, and terminal in a native app
uses_note: OpenIDEA is 16 days old. No independent user reports have been published yet.

coverage.title: OpenIDEA: el IDE en Rust que abre en 0,9 segundos
OpenIDEA rebuilds the IntelliJ-style IDE in Rust

steps: Download the installer for your OS from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/latest) (about 59 MB)
Open [OpenIDEA](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea) and load a project - it uses IntelliJ's keyboard shortcuts and layout by default
Try search-everywhere (press Shift twice) and the built-in database browser (Settings > Plugins)
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea
Then: Download from the Releases page, open a project, and try search-everywhere by pressing Shift twice. 10 minutes.

footprint.disk: About 59 MB for the installer (Linux RPM is 59.2 MB).
footprint.memory: About 169 MB idle with a project loaded (the project's own benchmark).
footprint.runs_on: macOS, Windows, Linux (x86-64 and ARM64). Building from source requires Rust 1.96+ and Node.js.

best_for: Developers who use IntelliJ and want the same experience with faster startup and less memory
Anyone whose current editor feels sluggish on large projects
skip_if: You're not a developer - this is a code editor for people who write code
You rely on a specific IntelliJ plugin - the add-on system is still in preview
You need a mature, battle-tested editor - OpenIDEA is 16 days old

alternatives.name: VS Code
alternatives.line: The most popular free code editor - slower than OpenIDEA but with a massive extension library

alternatives.name: Zed
alternatives.line: Another Rust-built code editor focused on speed, with multiplayer editing and AI features

watch: **Very new (16 days old).** Expect rough edges, missing features, and frequent changes.
**The benchmark is the project's own.** The maintainers note that IntelliJ analyzes Python more deeply, so 'ready' doesn't mean the same work was done on both sides.
**Add-on system is in preview.** If you depend on specific IntelliJ plugins, check whether they exist for OpenIDEA first.
**Not affiliated with JetBrains.** IntelliJ IDEA is a JetBrains trademark. OpenIDEA is a separate project.
